steps.title: Extrude the plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as stiffener.ipt.
Sketch on the YZ Plane: rectangle 418 wide x 5910 high, 50 mm up. Extrude 15 mm.

steps.title: Slots for the girders
actions: Sketch on the side face: eight rectangles 20 high and 209 deep from the flange edge, centred at the girder levels 150, 800, 1450, 2150, 2900, 3750, 4700, 5860. Extrude Cut Through All. Save.
steps.note: The stiffener slots over the girders from the downstream side.
